facts.statement: The study combined a re-analysis of public single-cell and spatial transcriptomic datasets with an examination of archived records from one specific thymoma cell line and a prepared dendritic cell model.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: Researchers used one normal adult thymus sample as a descriptive reference that was not matched to the disease samples.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: Analysis of donor-resolved single-cell data revealed that antigen-presentation genes were expressed across various antigen-presenting cell compartments, while IL21 transcripts were rare and mostly found in Tfh-like CD4+ T cells.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: Correlations between antigen-presentation and maturation/costimulation in two thymoma tissue sections weakened when statistical adjustments for other variables were applied.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The study found that the observed changes in the THP-1-derived cell preparation were due to the initial induction process rather than any effect from the Thy0517 thymoma cells.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: Data regarding IL-21 and IL-6 levels from a separate worksheet could not be used because the concentration units and calibration methods were unverified.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The authors state that their findings offer descriptive context for human tissue and cell models but do not prove that Thy0517 conditioning or IL-21 causes the specific mechanism of thymoma-associated myasthenia gravis.
facts.subject: humans
